pairs: Ecce tertio hoc venio ad vos:
Behold, this is the third time that I am coming to you.
in ore duorum vel trium testium stabit omne verbum.
By the mouth of two or three witnesses, every word shall stand.
and I will preach now while absent,
et nunc absens iis qui ante peccaverunt,
I will not be lenient with you.
An experimentum quæritis ejus, qui in me loquitur Christus,
Do you seek evidence that it is Christ who speaks in me,
who is not weak with you,
Nam etsi crucifixus est ex infirmitate:
For although he was crucified in weakness,
yet he lives by the power of God.
et nos infirmi sumus in illo:
sed vivemus cum eo ex virtute Dei in vobis.
But we shall live with him by the power of God among you.
Vosmetipsos tentate si estis in fide:
Test yourselves as to whether you are in the faith.
An non cognoscitis vosmetipsos quia Christus Jesus in vobis est?
Or do you yourselves not know whether Christ Jesus is in you?
Spero autem quod cognoscetis, quia nos non sumus reprobi.
But I hope you know that we ourselves are not reprobates.
Oramus autem Deum ut nihil mali faciatis,
Now we pray to God that you shall do nothing evil,
not so that we may seem to be approved,
sed ut vos quod bonum est faciatis:
but so that you may do what is good,
even if we seem like reprobates.
Non enim possumus aliquid adversus veritatem,
For we cannot do anything against the truth,
Gaudemus enim, quoniam nos infirmi sumus,
For we rejoice that we are weak,
This is also what we pray for: your perfection.
Therefore, I write these things while absent,
ut non præsens durius agam secundum potestatem,
so that, when present, I may not have to act more harshly,
quam Dominus dedit mihi in ædificationem,
according to the authority which the Lord has given to me,
for edification and not for destruction.
et Deus pacis et dilectionis erit vobiscum.
And so the God of peace and love will be with you.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ,
et communicatio Sancti Spiritus sit cum omnibus vobis.
and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
